project_description: CreditScore AI is an automated credit risk assessment system deployed by FinTrust Bank, a mid-sized retail bank operating in the UK and Germany. The system uses a gradient boosting ensemble model (XGBoost + LightGBM) trained on 5 years of historical loan repayment data to generate credit risk scores for personal loan applications between £1,000 and £50,000. The score is used by loan officers as one input in the final credit decision — the loan officer retains final decision authority and no application is auto-declined. The system processes applicant financial data, employment records, and credit bureau data via the Experian UK API. It does not process health, biometric, or children's data. The model is not generative and does not use any pre-trained foundation model. The bank operates in both the UK and Germany, creating dual UK/EU GDPR jurisdiction and a known fairness risk (self-employed applicant disparity) that is actively monitored and being remediated.
